digest.component_or_area: route reconciler differ/apply core-importer off vendor mappers via dependency injection
propositions: The reconciler core modules (outbound_differ, inbound_differ, apply_inbound) must receive vendor MAPPER entrypoints via Backend-port dependency injection instead of direct module-level imports.
Mapper injection is verified by AST assertions confirming absence of direct vendor MAPPER imports and by positive tests exercising the injected mapper.
outbound_links._RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK must be single-sourced in adapters/jira/jira_fields.py to eliminate duplication and maintain the vendor abstraction boundary.
Non-mapping vendor helpers with no Backend-port equivalent (outbound_fields helpers, reconcile_check internal loads) remain directly imported as a documented residual scope boundary.
Behavior preservation is validated by the full reconcile unit and integration test suite passing and whole-tree test collection succeeding without errors.
